messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — automation run this morning sent duplicate playbook emails to 3 customers (auto-onboard playbook). Notified via support threads. :rotating_light:
liam_pm: ack. Can you paste event ids? Is this the webhook retry loop we saw last month?
maria_cs: examples: ACCT-9012, ACCT-9044, ACCT-9077. Support ticket IDs: #2345, #2346. I dug into logs — saw repeated POSTs from CRM with same `event_id` but our handler created new PlaybookExecutions.
olivia_ops: that suggests missing idempotency by `event_id` — we should ignore if we've processed same external_id within 1h.
maria_cs: exactly. Quick patch idea: when processing webhook, check `external_event_id` and write a row to `playbook_event_log(external_id, created_at)` with unique constraint. If conflict, drop.
rashid_data: SQL to find dupes:
```
SELECT external_event_id, count(*) c, array_agg(account_id) accounts
FROM playbook_event_log
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY external_event_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
rashid_data: ran that, found 3 external_event_ids that match the account list maria gave.
julia_csm: fyi — customers got two "welcome" emails within 10m. One forwarded to PMs as 'why did I get two'. Need to send apology? maybe manual outreach first.
liam_pm: ops plan: block new playbook dispatches for the affected accounts until fix. Can we script a temporary block?
olivia_ops: yes. I'll create a quick `pending_block` flag in Redis keyed by account id for 2h and have dispatcher check it. Deployment in 10m.
devops-bot: deploy started: playbook-dispatcher v2.14.3 -> staging
maria_cs: also need a durable fix in backend: add DB unique constraint and ensure webhook handler uses `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` and returns 200 even on duplicates.
rashid_data: suggested dedupe window: 1h default, config per-playbook. This avoids accidental repeat for long-running retries.
liam_pm: agree. Also add monitoring alert: if duplicate rate > 0.1% in 1h, page CS-ops.
julia_csm: can someone add this to the runbook? I'll update the CS playbook doc.
olivia_ops: adding to runbook. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/playbook-dispatcher/pulls/88
maria_cs: postmortem action items:
- ops: deploy Redis block (olivia)
- infra: add unique constraint + code change (rashid/dev)
- cs: outreach template + manual send (julia)
- pm: update runbook & alerting (liam)
liam_pm: assign owners and ETA?
olivia_ops: deployed block in 8m. ETA for infra code change: EOD today.
rashid_data: I'll open the DB migration PR now.
julia_csm: drafting apology template, will circulate.
liam_pm: thanks all. Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
